body: Check the v0.1.0 release and then update it @sepo-agent /answer

comments.body:
Here's what I found after checking the v0.1.0 release at [`self-evolving/repo`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/releases/tag/v0.1.0):

---

## Current state

This repo's sepo installation predates the v0.1.0 release (installed ~May 4; v0.1.0 published May 12). The `.agent/package.json` already says `"version": "0.1.0"` but that's the package name/version string — the actual runtime files are from a snapshot before the release was cut.

## What's new in v0.1.0

Key differences vs this repo's current install:

| Area | Change |
|---|---|
| `acpx` dependency | `^0.4.0` → `^0.6.1` (Claude auto-permission mode support) |
| `agent-onboarding.yml` | New first-run onboarding workflow |
| `agent-project-manager.yml` | New project management workflow |
| `agent-release-prepare.yml` | New release prep workflow |
| `agent-update.yml` | **New automated update workflow** (scheduled biweekly, also manually triggerable) |
| Source files | ~249 tracked files with changes across routing, orchestration, rubrics, inline review cleanup, self-approval, stacked PRs, sub-issues, etc. |

## Upgrade procedure

The upgrade is a file sync from `self-evolving/repo@v0.1.0`:

1. **Copy `.agent/`** — replace entirely from `self-evolving/repo@v0.1.0` (preserves no repo-specific content there)
2. **Copy `.github/workflows/agent-*.yml`** — replace all `agent-*.yml` files; **keep `deploy.yml`** (site-specific Quartz workflow)
3. **Merge `.gitignore`** — ensure `.agent/dist/` and `.agent/node_modules/` remain ignored (already present per memory)
4. Open and merge the update PR

Once `agent-update.yml` is installed, future upgrades can be triggered via **Actions → Agent / Update** (manual dispatch) or run automatically on the 1st and 15th of each month from `self-evolving/repo`'s latest stable release.

---

Want me to proceed with implementing this upgrade as a PR?
